message.content:
Buddhism was founded by **Siddhartha Gautama**, who is commonly referred to as the **Buddha** (“the awakened one”).  
He was born in the 5th‑century BCE in what is today **Lumbini, Nepal** (then part of ancient India). After attaining enlightenment under the Bodhi tree at **Bodh Gaya, India**, he began teaching his insights, establishing the early Buddhist community in the Indian subcontinent.
